unifieddb_identity.important_limit: identity/fingerprint is not a full SQLite state snapshot and does not prove all runtime participants opened the same database

emergent_retrieval.important_limit: no UnifiedDB persistence/query credit; retrieval result remains candidate/reference evidence

stale_surface_conflict.observation: human ledger still labels Phase-3/4 items NOT_STARTED while granular receipts already exist for multiple Phase-3/4 workpackages
stale_surface_conflict.rule: granular exact receipts outrank stale aggregate/human ledger for scoped acceptance claims

authority_fences: Projection is derived/rebuildable and never becomes a second canonical truth store.
Deleting the projection must lose zero canonical evidence.
Projection output is a derived evidence view/candidate input, never truth minting, contradiction resolution, completion authority or effect authority.
EffectGate/EffectJournal remain the only real-effect authority.
No Graphiti server, Neo4j, FalkorDB, Neptune, LLM extraction or provider dependency is required by this candidate.

logical_source_binding_contract.note: These are required logical bindings, not invented current SQLite column names. Trigger 4 must map them to the exact then-current canonical F2 persistence API/schema before implementation credit.

time_semantics.as_of_system: Which canonical evidence had been observed/admitted by system time S?
time_semantics.as_of_valid: For which represented-world validity time V is the evidence claim active?
time_semantics.history_law: Historical reconstruction requires both coordinates. A CURRENT shortcut may be implemented explicitly but must never masquerade as historical truth-as-known-then.

candidate_query_contract.name: lookup_bitemporal
rules: Exactly one active source-bound candidate may return ONE.
No active candidate returns NONE/UNKNOWN-like absence; it must not be promoted to false world fact.
More than one simultaneously active candidate at the same query coordinates fails closed as AMBIGUOUS; no last-write-wins.
Generation or source identity mismatch fails closed before candidate use.

required_invariants: canonical evidence is unchanged by projection build/query/delete/rebuild
projection deletion plus deterministic rebuild preserves canonical source identities and yields the same rebuild digest for the same source identity plus projection schema/version
historical query requires both system/observation time and valid time
retroactive corrections preserve the pre-correction truth-as-known-then view at earlier system time
invalidation/supersession preserves historical evidence instead of destructively hiding it
overlapping active versions fail closed as ambiguity
exact source provenance/digest/generation round-trips through projection results
source mutation or generation change after build makes the projection stale until verified rebuild/refresh
projection/ranking/model inference cannot create canonical evidence
candidate projection may feed retrieval/world-model/GWT only as noncanonical evidence
no provider or external graph service is needed for deterministic operation

deterministic rebuild from identical exact canonical source identity

explicit CURRENT vs HISTORICAL query semantic separation
external provider/Graphiti service unavailable with deterministic native path still functional
benchmark_requirements: actual current baseline vs projection p50/p95/p99 query latency
persistent SQLite page/storage cost if implemented inside/adjacent to UnifiedDB
RSS/PSS or equivalent memory cost where meaningful
correctness and ambiguity counts before performance interpretation
